Resolves #19462

Closing a legacy dashboard popup restores the original widget once and makes it visible immediately. The disconnect owner silently releases the closed popup, retires any source sorting reservation, and acknowledges that removal before reinserting into a mounted source. Per-entry coordination prevents duplicate disconnects or an old return from overtaking a newer admission.

Evidence: L3 local browser gestures and three-surface checks → L4 installed FM candidate required for AC-6. Residual: AC-6, Residual-Owner: neomjs/neo-agent-institution#12.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; change class is restoration. Repository pre-commit checks passed; final-head Engine/shared baseline jobs run on this PR.

## Deltas from ticket

The blank view required more than removing duplicate references: a closed-popup render could wedge, and same-batch source removal/reinsertion concealed the missing DOM node. The fix stays in the legacy dashboard owner and reuses container removal, insertion and `promiseUpdate()`. Generic insertion and drag admission are unchanged.

## Test Evidence

- Combined popup-return and header-admission browser journeys pass together (2/2); [exact-head integration receipt](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/19464#issuecomment-6053798161).
- Local browser journey passes with three header tear-out/close cycles, immediate restoration, hidden-source return, retained body content and drag-back reintegration. It reuses existing examples with test-only handle/popup configuration.
- The earlier browser falsifier reproduced the missing pane and wedged viewport. Silencing the popup update removed the warning; acknowledging source removal completed the visible return. [Bounded receipt](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19462#issuecomment-6050563648).
- CI-covered units live in `unit/dashboard/Container.spec.mjs`; full-unit validation and the retained unrelated reporter false positive are documented in the same receipt. No unrelated reporter change is included.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge:**
- *Edge case, accepted:* both removals run before `insert`. If `insert` threw, `finally` would clear `returning`, but the widget would belong to neither container while its `detachedItems` entry survives. With the popup gone, no later disconnect would retry it. `insert` of a live instance is not expected to throw, so this is not a Required Action.
- *Assumption I checked:* the December session worried that `removeAt(…, false)` leaves the widget with `mounted = false`. The journey asserts visibility before hide/show, survives three close cycles and ends with drag-back reintegration. Each of these would fail on a widget left unmounted.
